summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a 6-K urging shareholder approval of its acquisition by Equinox Gold Corp. under a court-approved plan of arrangement. ISS supports the deal, and Orla's board unanimously recommends a FOR vote. The special meeting is set for July 22, 2026, with a proxy deadline of July 20, 2026. Terms from the May 12 arrangement agreement are not detailed here, but the filing signals imminent shareholder vote. Watch for vote outcome and potential regulatory approvals; risk-arb spread may tighten as deadline approaches.
